notes: All of Ravel's original works with a principal violin part are already listed: the posthumous Sonata M. 12, Sonata No. 2 M. 77, Tzigane, the Berceuse sur le nom de Gabriel Fauré and the Sonata for Violin and Cello M. 73. The main established transcriptions (Garban's Kaddisch, Heifetz's Valses nobles, the Habanera and the Pavane) are also present; I left out other possible arrangements because I cannot name an edition for them with confidence.
